title: Gene sets x Phenotypes in source (dev)
bodyHtml:
To get started, select a CFDE program (glygen, gtex, idg, komp, lincs, or motrpac) or use the search box above to find datasets from the intersections of two programs  (e.g., glygen_x_gtex).

KC differential expression analysis GlyGen GTEx gene expression in aging GTEx tissue-specific expression IDG coexpression IDG putative drug targets Knockout mouse project LINCS chemical perturbations LINCS gene knockouts MoTrPAC

Click the Research Method tab to find full details about datasets, gene sets, phenotypes, and analysis methods.

The plot compares the marginal and joint effect graphically across gene sets.

The table shows all relationships for the chosen source.
dataVisualizerLegendHtml:
In the plot below, dots represent the DE values for gene-tissue-phenotype combinations; larger dots indicate higher mean expression. Hover over a dot to see its underlying data. Dots are colored in gray (nonsignificant values on both axes), green (significant values on one axis only), or red (significant values on both axes). Download the plot using the button on the right.

Fold change values (log2) >0.5 or <-0.5 (vertical dotted line) and adjusted p-values (-log10) >1.3 (horizontal dotted line) are considered statistically significant.
